title: Engineering Policies
text: Engineering employees receive 20 days of annual leave. Engineering employees can request remote work up to three days per week. Production deployments require approval from the engineering manager. Engineering code repositories must use mandatory code review before production deployment. Critical production incidents must be reported to the engineering manager immediately.

title: HR Policies
text: HR manages employee compensation information. Salary information is confidential and accessible only to authorized HR personnel. Employees receive benefits including health insurance and annual leave. New employees must complete their onboarding documentation with HR. Employee performance reviews are conducted annually.

title: Finance Policies
text: Finance manages company budgets and expense approvals. Expenses above 100000 INR require director approval. Quarterly financial reports are available to finance employees. Employees must submit business expenses with valid receipts. Finance reviews departmental budgets every quarter.

title: Company-wide Policies
text: All employees receive health insurance. All employees can claim annual leave according to company policy. The company observes national public holidays. Employees can access the company employee handbook. Company-wide announcements are available to all employees.
